name: sharpps-mcp
description: SharpPS developer services over MCP: remote Playwright testing and reports, identity groups, Chrome DevTools, remote shells, attendance, and trading tools.

interface.longDescription: Connect to SharpPS developer services over MCP: run remote Playwright tests and inspect reports, manage identity groups, inspect Chrome sessions, run authorized remote shell tasks, access attendance workflows, and use trading tools. Sign in with OAuth when prompted; Replayr may also accept an API token.
